transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what's been bothering you or what brings you here today?

Well, I guess... I'm here because of what happens after I eat. Sometimes I just... I don't know, I eat a lot. And then I just sit there in my truck, looking at all the empty wrappers and containers. I just feel disgusted with myself. It's... it makes me feel like I'm not the steady, in-control man I've always tried to be.
After you eat a lot, do you ever try to get rid of the food or compensate for it in some way, like making yourself vomit?
No. I don't... I've never done anything like that. I just sit there with it.
Does this eating behavior interfere with your daily life, like causing you to avoid social situations or feel anxious about it when you're not doing it?

I suppose it does. I... well, I usually mentor some of the newer drivers. But lately, I've been letting their check-in calls go to voicemail. I just... I don't want to talk to them right now. I guess I'm just ashamed. I don't want anyone hearing how far off my routine I've gotten.
How often do you find yourself eating a lot in one sitting like this?

Well... I've been off the road lately, stuck at home with a back injury. So... it's been happening pretty often. I guess... several nights most weeks. If I really think about it, I don't think there's been a single week in these past three months where I didn't have... at least one of those nights.
Has this eating behavior affected other areas of your life, like your work, home responsibilities, or relationships?
Not really... I mean, I'm already off work because of my back. I mostly just keep to myself anyway. So... I don't know. I haven't noticed it messing with anything else.
Do you feel distressed or upset about these eating episodes, even when you're not in the middle of them?

Yeah... I do. That's... well, that's why I'm here, I guess. After it's over, I just sit there and look at all the empty wrappers and containers. I just... I feel disgusted with myself. I've always been a steady guy, you know? In control. And looking at that mess... it just makes me feel like I'm not that man anymore.
When you're eating a lot in one of these episodes, do you feel like you can't stop or control what you're doing?

Yeah... I guess so. It's just... once I start eating, it's like all that discipline I used to have out on the road just... shuts off. I'll be sitting there, telling myself, 'Magin, put the fork down.' But... I don't know. My hand just keeps going back for more. I can't seem to stop it.
Do you feel unhappy with your body shape or weight, or does it cause you a lot of distress how you look?
No, not really. I mean... I'm a big guy. Always have been. It's just... it is what it is. I don't spend much time thinking about how I look.
When you're eating a lot in one of these episodes, does it feel like you're consuming a much larger amount of food than most people would eat in a similar period of time?

Yeah, I suppose so. Um... some evenings I'll heat up a bowl of pozole, thinking it's just one bowl. But... I don't know. Before I know it, I've emptied the whole pot. Then maybe a couple of tamales, some chips... whatever leftovers are around. It's... well, it's like I'm feeding a whole crew instead of just me. So, yeah. A lot of food.
